description: This file implements the RunC container management class and its administrator, including container lifecycle operations (create, start, stop, delete), state querying, and configuration handling, specifically for the runc runtime.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Encapsulates runc command execution, managing container creation, execution, deletion, and state retrieval.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a runc-based container, providing lifecycle management and resource info.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages container creation and retrieval, acting as a factory for RunCContainer instances.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the container administrator, logs runc version.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on configuration files found in search paths.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container if running.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory resource info for the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns CPU resource info for the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interface info (not implemented, returns nullptr).

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Deletes the container if it is running.
